title: Onboarding playbook: template app screenshots, README flow diagrams, and quickstart visual checklist
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Produce a cohesive onboarding playbook for template apps: deliver reference app screenshots (desktop + mobile), README flow diagrams (SVG + PNG), and a visual quickstart checklist for release v1.4 docs. Assets will be consumed by engineering quickstarts, SDK README, and the Console onboarding modal.
acceptance_criteria: All primary flows captured with annotated screenshots: install, API key configure, first request, streaming response, error state
README flow diagram exported as SVG + optimized PNG at 2x for docs site
Accessible alt text written for each screenshot and included in the asset manifest
Design assets uploaded to Drive with clear naming convention and versioned folder
Asset checklist reviewed and approved by PM and Eng lead
PR opened linking assets and example code into docs repo with screenshots embedded
tasks: Audit existing reference-app flows and pick 6 canonical screens
Create mobile and desktop artboards, apply new console color tokens
Annotate each screenshot with short callouts and suggested alt text
Draft README flow diagram showing onboarding steps and where to insert code snippets
Export assets following docs-image-spec (2x PNG, webp fallback) and compress
Upload final assets to Drive and paste links into the docs PR
Collect review feedback from PM (Jia Chen) and Eng (Marcus Lee) and iterate
screenshots_guidelines: Use real API key redaction component to show masked value (do not show real keys)
Include small caption for each image: context + expected user action
Highlight the live 'Try it' button state and streaming progress indicator
Show one error state with recommended troubleshooting hint

2026-03-12 - Accessibility review (Samira K.): request to include alt text and ensure color contrast for callouts >= 4.5:1
2026-03-13 - UX review (Ravi Patel): approved composition, asked for one additional microcopy tweak in the README diagram
design_decisions: Prefer flat annotations over speech-bubble callouts to reduce visual noise in README
Use Console primary token blue (#0A66FF) for CTAs to align with product branding
Export diagrams as both SVG and optimized PNG to support docs site and PDF printables
Avoid showing real user data in screenshots; use synthetic example inputs and masked keys
next_steps: Implement microcopy tweak and re-export diagrams (owner: Ravi)
Push final assets to Drive and update docs PR with image paths (owner: Ava)
Notify SDK writers to swap in new screenshots after merge (owner: PM Jia Chen)
Schedule a quick release review with Eng lead Marcus Lee on 2026-03-18
